config.description: v023's exact recipe and architecture at 2x the largest model we have ever built: hidden 285, 871,977 params against v023's 225,922 and against 435,943 for dozken's reset2k (the biggest thing we have run). Same 2-layer GRU, same 64-unit GELU+LayerNorm input projection over concat[normalised, first differences] (224), same projection-to-readout skip, same LayerNorm+GELU MLP head, same state reset every 2,000, same chunk 1,000, same distillation against dozken's reset2k replayed as exact teacher labels at weight 0.5. ONLY hidden changes, 128 -> 285.
config.hypothesis: The student has never been LARGER than its teacher. v022 (321,602) and v023 (225,922) are both below the 435,943-param teacher and both plateau ~0.005 BELOW it, which is the whole remaining gap. The natural explanation we have never tested is that the student is capacity limited rather than teacher limited, and every student we have tried has been squeezed below the teacher. At 871,977 params this one is 200% of its teacher, so if the deficit is a capacity ceiling this is the experiment that breaks it. If it is NOT fixed here, the ceiling is the teacher's knowledge and no student size will reach it -- which is itself the answer, and the more valuable one. Deliberately run with no latency constraint: the fused graph puts this at ~69 us/row, which projects past the 60-min target on the grader, so this is a measurement, not a ship candidate.
config.change_vs_parent: hidden 128 -> 285 ONLY. 225,922 -> 871,977 params, exactly 2.00x the largest model we have run (435,943). Nothing else moves: same architecture, same teacher, same distill_weight 0.5, same loss, same optimiser, same batch 16, same 3 epochs, same chunk 1,000, same state_reset 2,000, same features.
